sectionB.title: Section B: Short Answer Questions
sectionB.instruction: Attempt any EIGHT questions from this section. Each question carries Three (3) marks.
questions: Mitochondria are called the 'Power house of the cell'. Explain it in three points.
Write the three differences between apoptosis and necrosis.
Define Biodiversity and explain the importance of it.
What is cell theory? And state its postulates.
Define the following: (i) Heterotrophic nutrition (ii) Vitamins (iii) Biotechnology
Write any three effects of malnutrition in human.
Define Karyokinesis and describe the main events of prophase mitosis.
State the important carbohydrates in the continuation of life processes in living organisms.
Explain the composition and importance of Plasma in blood.
Describe the relationship of Biology with any other three science branches.
Draw neat and labelled diagram of a plant cell.
State the causes of deforestation and its effects on biodiversity.

sectionC.title: Section C: Detailed Answer Questions
sectionC.instruction: Attempt any FOUR questions from this section. Each question carries SIX (6) marks.
questions: Draw neat and labelled diagram of Human Alimentary canal.

Define mitosis, write its different stages and explain any two of them.
Describe simple permanent tissues in detail.
Describe pulmonary and systemic circulation of blood in the human heart and state their importance.
Define respiration. Write aerobic and anaerobic respiration with chemical equations.
